shared_elements: large freestanding sculpture in the round of a single subject
hunched, block-like body with head at top
curved/hooked beak-like or nose-like projection on head
relief patterning over the body surface
justification: Both are single-subject sculptures in the round with a heavy hunched body, a broad head with a prominent downcurved beak/nose profile at the top, and low-relief detailing worked over the body mass. But A depicts a seated/standing anthropomorphic figure with an elaborate headdress, incised symbolic motifs, a pectoral disc and belt bands, while B depicts a bird with folded striated wings and taloned feet; the shared traits (blocky monolithic form, hooked profile) are generic rather than a shared specific iconographic scheme.
